name: claude-md-claim-drift-guard
title: Correct the falsified CLAUDE.md behavior claims and guard them mechanically
description: A read-only audit on 2026-09-03 falsified seven claims in CLAUDE.md. Grouped onto five correction items they are: the agent prompt asset section (one claim); the story channel count (one claim); the story artifact directory rule (one claim); one stale story-review.ts line citation, one stale attribution of the INIT_CHECK blocker definitions, and one link to a file absent from the repository (three claims); and an incomplete host hook inventory together with three gate-required commands the document never names (one claim). The existing docs-drift preflight cannot catch any of them because it only checks command-name registration plus a path check that skips docs/story paths. Add a claim verifier that fails on the current document, then correct each falsified section until the verifier passes.
